name: Elite Licenser Lite – Software License Key Manager
author: appsbd

sections.description:
Elite Licenser Lite is an advanced WordPress plugin for product licensing and updates. It includes an automatic license generator, built-in Envato licensing verification, full license control, and more. With a complete set of APIs, you can integrate it with other applications. You can manage licenses for multiple products, including WordPress plugins, themes, and applications developed in PHP, .Net, Java, and Android.

Video Overview

Key Features

  • Prevent Nulled Versions: Secure your products by generating license scripts that prevent unauthorized use.
  • Universal Licensing Solution: Supports licensing for WordPress plugins, themes, PHP applications, Joomla, .Net, Java, and Android applications.
  • Automatic Product Updates: Notify users about updates and display update prompts directly in WordPress.
  • 3rd Party App Hooks: Instantly notify external applications (e.g., membership apps) when a client purchases a license.
  • Customizable Email Templates: Modify and automate email communications for customers.
  • Envato Integration: Built-in support for Envato license verification, plus the ability to integrate other marketplaces.
  • Plug-and-Play Code Generation: Generate ready-to-use licensing code for WordPress plugins, themes, and other platforms.
  • Auto Host Ban: Automatically block domains that repeatedly attempt unauthorized activations.
  • Full API Support: Provides complete API access to manage licenses and control permissions.
  • Flexible License Verification: Customize verification intervals to balance security and server performance.
  • Force License Removal: Revoke licenses for fraudulent customers or refund cases.
  • Single App for All Licenses: Manage all licenses from one centralized installation.
  • Custom License Types: Create and manage different license types such as single-use, multi-domain, and yearly licenses.
  • URL-Based Restrictions: Prevent unauthorized installations by linking licenses to specific URLs.
  • Detailed License Logs: Track where and when each license was activated.
  • Future Addons Support: New addons will be available to enhance the system with additional features.

Supported Payment Gateways

Elite Licenser Lite also integrates with various payment gateways for seamless license management.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin in your WordPress application.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Access the Elite Licenser Lite menu.
  4. Configure your licensing settings and start managing licenses.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce for auto-generating license keys?

Yes, if you link a WooCommerce product to an Elite Licenser product, a license key will be generated automatically upon purchase based on quantity.
